channel.title: Nona Digi Blog
channel.description: Practical notes on AI search visibility, AI chat receptionists, and local business growth — from the team at Nona Digi.

item.title: We Asked an AI Assistant 35 Questions. Here's What It Means for Your HVAC Company
item.description: Homeowners now ask ChatGPT which HVAC company to call. We ran 35 unbranded questions through an AI assistant to learn who gets recommended and why. Here is the pattern, translated for HVAC.

item.title: For dental practices: the questions patients ask at midnight
item.description: Tooth pain and worry do not keep office hours. The questions prospective patients type late at night decide who gets booked by morning — and the practice that answers helpfully at midnight is usually the one that wins the appointment.

item.title: Frequently asked questions: the cheapest visibility upgrade on your website
item.description: The questions your customers already ask are sitting in your phone calls and inbox. Answering them plainly on one page helps nervous customers, search engines, and AI assistants at the same time — for the cost of one afternoon.

item.title: Why AI assistants recommend businesses with recent reviews
item.description: When an AI assistant names one business, recent and specific reviews are a big part of why. Here is how to earn them honestly: ask at the happy moment, make it one tap, reply to every review, and never buy or invent a single one.

item.title: Your Google Business Profile Is Your New Homepage: A Plain-English Tune-Up
item.description: For many customers, your Google Business Profile is the first — and sometimes only — page they see. The same details feed AI assistants. Here is a plain-English tune-up: categories, services, hours, photos, questions, and reviews, all in customer words.

item.title: After Hours Is When Leads Go Quiet: What Happens to the 7 in the Evening Enquiry
item.description: A customer finds your website at 7 in the evening, ready to book — and meets silence. Here is the typical story of that enquiry, hour by hour, and the simple fix: an instant first answer while the intention is still warm.

item.title: What an AI Chat Receptionist Actually Does All Day
item.description: An AI chat receptionist is not a smarter contact form. It greets your website visitors, answers questions from your own facts, checks your calendar, books appointments, and captures leads after hours — in your voice, in chat. Here is a day in its life.

item.title: The questions customers ask AI assistants about your industry, and how to hear them
item.description: Customers ask AI assistants real questions about your industry — who to call, what it costs, who can come today — and the answers decide who gets recommended. Those questions are not secret. Here is how to hear them and answer them on your website.

item.title: Why your best customers now ask an AI assistant before they search
item.description: More customers now ask ChatGPT or Gemini who to call — and act on the short list they get back. If your business is not in that answer, you never get the call. Here is what assistants base their recommendations on, and what it means for a local business.
